column1: # modal-census.tsv — committed expected values for verify-protocol.sh check `modals`
# One row per `## ` section of PROTOCOL.md at the round-13 baseline (526 lines,
# The key is an ASCII prefix of the heading; the check opens a section at the first
# line whose start matches the key and closes it at the next `## ` line.
# Token set and counting command (the exact one used to derive every floor below):
# GNU grep -oE resolves alternatives leftmost-longest, so the phrase `must not` is
# counted as the single token `must not` (observed baseline breakdown: 16 `must`,
# measured at the baseline, so any net loss of normative tokens in a section --
# including a modal weakened to a non-token word -- trips the check.
#   for each key: awk section slice | grep -oE "$MODAL_RE" | wc -l
